title: The AITask tree, lanes, outline and flow views: mapped, screenshotted, and wired into the task page

chat.text: You found good visualizations in the AITask module that seem wired to nothing. A Sonnet task mastermind maps every view with a screenshot on a real task, says which page uses it today and which task built it, then puts them on the task detail page as a view switcher so a task's flow and lanes are one click away.
